g.text: Four UML Relationships, the Same Five Class Pairs
Same-looking diamond notation, four different concrete answers to "what happens if I delete the container?"
ASSOCIATION -- uses a reference, no ownership
Deleting Controller: Service is unaffected either way.
AGGREGATION (hollow diamond) -- has-a, parts can outlive the whole
COMPOSITION (filled diamond) -- has-a, parts cannot outlive the whole
Deleting Order: its LineItems are deleted too.
